name: The Black Tower
description: A tower of black stone that leans over the northern rim of the land.

tower_gate.name: Tower Gate
tower_gate.description: The great door stands open at last. A stair climbs into smoke.

throne_stair.name: Throne Stair
throne_stair.description: A spiral stair, its steps worn to slopes by centuries of boots.

malgrath_hall.name: Hall of Malgrath
malgrath_hall.description: A round hall under a broken roof. The sky is the colour of a bruise.
